correctness.rationale: The positive fiber of an exact-two Hamming query is the edge set of K_d; query positivity reduces exactly to two-set exclusive incidence or four-set containment. A near-star permits no depth-three tree, hence a two-star permits no depth-four tree and the full edge fiber no depth-five tree. Therefore the original class has Littlestone dimension at most five. A 32-row, seven-bit five-query witness was replayed from package files, establishing VC at least five and hence both equal five for all d>=7 by zero padding. Quantifiers and branch-size bounds were checked case by case; no finite experiment is used as an infinite upper-bound proof.

originality.rationale: The exact-distance-two predicate differs from distance-one adjacency and from ball membership. The highly relevant full 2020 arXiv preprint, later 2022 published, defines its Hamming edge relation as disagreement in precisely one coordinate, derives the VC ceiling three, and mentions distance-two layers only for clique-width. That theorem cannot entail a class with five shattered queries. The comparison to Johnson-neighborhood bounds also fails implication because this new positive fiber admits four-set containment queries. Search of published-finding corpus, prior research records and other web sources did not identify covering claims; negative search is not a priority guarantee.

value.rationale: Determines exact static and adaptive shattering for the second Hamming sphere in every binary dimension d>=7; the original 2020 Hamming adjacency literature instead treats radius one, where VC is at most three. The sharp universal ceiling despite exponentially many centers, and the two-star/near-star structural mechanism, are meaningful invariants of the Hamming association scheme. The precise value five is witnessed by five natural bit-vector queries rather than a narrow arbitrary numerical instance.
